about: The audition reel: the same short scenes for everyone trying out for any part, so they can be compared fairly. Each is chosen for what it asks of the flat cards as well as of the character, so a problem shows up here and not after someone is cast.

sides.name: Stand easy
sides.why: Holding still. A card that keeps swapping its picture while nothing moves shows up as a shimmer.

sides.name: Walk
sides.why: What the world sees most. The hips and knees, over and over.

sides.name: Run
sides.why: The knees and elbows bend further and faster than in a walk.

sides.name: Wave
sides.why: A shoulder and an elbow up high, beside the face.

sides.name: Head turn
sides.why: The neck, which is still being worked on. Does the face stay a face from the side?

sides.name: Arm overhead
sides.why: A shoulder at its furthest. Cards open most here.

sides.name: Deep squat
sides.why: The knees broke here before. Held, so you can look.

sides.name: A beat of the candy-shop routine
sides.why: Eight seconds of the crew's dance, in the candidate's place in the line. Elbows and hips, in step with the others.

sides.name: Tag moves
sides.why: A dodge, a tag and being tagged: quick turns that make cards swap pictures fast.

sides.name: A sparring bout
sides.why: Jabs, a hook and a block from the fight kit, opposite Lincoln. Fists come close to faces.

sides.name: Stand easy (screen test)
sides.why: Holding nearly still, the weight going from foot to foot. A card that swaps its picture while nothing much moves shows as a shimmer, and the hips and ankles take a small side-to-side load.

sides.name: Walk out and back (screen test)
sides.why: A quick change of direction: a planted foot pivots, the hips turn half round under a moving body, then the walk again the other way. Cards swap pictures fast in the turn.

sides.name: Jog on the spot (screen test)
sides.why: Knees lifted to the hip and both elbows held well bent and pumping, quicker than a walk, without going anywhere. Both feet leave the floor between steps.

sides.name: Deep squat (screen test)
sides.why: The knees and hips folded as far as they go, and the ankles bent forward under them. The knees broke here before.

sides.name: Reach and stretch (screen test)
sides.why: Both shoulders at their furthest overhead, where cards open most, then the spine bending to each side under them.

sides.name: Look around (screen test)
sides.why: The neck alone: turning each way and nodding up and down while the body stays put. Does the face stay a face from the side, and does the head stay on the collar?

sides.name: Wave with each hand (screen test)
sides.why: Each shoulder raised and each elbow bent up high beside the face, one side and then the other, so left and right can be compared.

sides.name: Pick something up (screen test)
sides.why: A bend all the way to the floor: the spine folded forward, the hips and knees bent, an arm reaching down past the shins. The head goes below the hips' height.

sides.name: Turn round on the spot (screen test)
sides.why: The whole body seen from every side in one go, the feet stepping round under it. Every card shows every picture it has.

sides.name: Arm circles (screen test)
sides.why: The shoulders through their whole round: up overhead, out, down and back behind the body, where a card shows its back.

sides.name: Forward lunge (screen test)
sides.why: One knee deep in front, the other near the floor behind with its hip stretched open: the two legs at the far ends of their range at once.

sides.name: Shrug and bow (screen test)
sides.why: The collar bones lifted in a hard shrug (where the neck's piece meets the chest), then the spine and neck bending forward together in the bow.

sides.name: Twist side to side (screen test)
sides.why: The spine turning on the hips each way while the feet stay put: the chest's cards and the hips' cards point different ways.

sides.name: Front kick (screen test)
sides.why: One hip folded high with its knee snapping straight, the whole body balanced on the other foot. Kimodo has seen plenty of fighting.

run.made_by: just runs (one sentence to Kimodo on RunPod, then free)

library.made_by: just screen-motions go (once, for everyone: a few cents of Kimodo on RunPod), then just screen-play <run> (free; the tape plays them too)
